• Type: stolon
  • Origin: Asia
  • Height: 20-30+ cm after two months in the tank
  • Light demand: low
  • CO2 demand: low

Vallisneria sp. Gigantea from Asia is an easy plant that grows fast, suitable for large aquariums. In most aquariums the leaves grow so long that they float on the surface (50-150 cm, 2 cm wide). So the plant needs pruning to stop it taking too much light from plants growing beneath.
The leaves are tough and strong, so they are not normally eaten by herbivorous fish. Vallisneria americana easily propagates through runners, which are prolific if the bottom is nutritious.
